401 Unauthorized error on stream initiation before any chunks are received

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const liter_llm = @import("liter_llm");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _api_key = std.c.getenv("API_KEY") orelse return error.MissingApiKey;
    var _client = try liter_llm.create_client(std.mem.span(_api_key), null, null, null, null);
    defer _client.free();
    const _stream_result: anyerror!void = stream_result: {
        var _stream = _client.chat_stream("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"stream\":true}") catch |_start_err| break :stream_result _start_err;
        defer _stream.deinit();
        while (true) {
            const _chunk = _stream.next() catch |_next_err| break :stream_result _next_err;
            if (_chunk == null) break :stream_result {};
        }
    };
    if (_stream_result) |_| {
        return error.TestUnexpectedResult;
    } else |err| { std.debug.print("call failed as expected: {s}\n", .{@errorName(err)}); }
}
```
